title: Visualize routing decision journeys for pinned models, canaries, and fallback variants
creator: Asha Raman
description: Goal: Design a console UX that makes the runtime's routing decisions for model version pinning, canary/A-B rollouts, tier routing, and cross-region fallbacks transparent and actionable for engineers and SREs. The feature should let users trace a single request (or aggregated cohort) through the routing resolver, show why a particular model variant was selected (pin, region, tier, or fallback), surface latency/cost tradeoffs, and provide clear remediation actions (re-pin, pause rollout, or force fallback). This ticket covers information architecture, new visualizations, micro-interactions for rollout controls, and copy for guardrails and tooltips.
success_metrics: 10% reduction in debug time for routing incidents measured by post-incident surveys
80% of users can identify why a request hit a fallback variant in 30s during usability tests
Decrease in PagerDuty alerts caused by unexpected rollout routing by 15% in first quarter after launch
scope: Request trace view with routing decision waterfall
Rollout timeline with canary cohorts and region/tier overlays
Pin management surface showing precedence order and effective affinity
Action buttons: re-pin to version, pause rollout, promote canary
Telemetry links to latency/cost dashboards and related GitHub PRs
out_of_scope: Full rollout orchestration automation (handled by infra)
constraints: Must fit within existing Console's React component library and design tokens
Limited vertical space on route details page; designs should collapse and expand
Read-only mode for users without deploy permissions; controls must be disabled with explainer tooltip
accessibility_notes: Color choices must maintain 4.5:1 contrast for status badges
Provide keyboard-accessible timeline scrubbing and aria-labels for decision nodes
telemetry_requirements: Each decision node in the UI must surface the resolver rule ID and request sample ID
Add event for 'ui.repin_clicked' with context: project, route, old_version, new_version
artifacts: GitHub mock PR for console components: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4567
